name: startune
description: Organize, prune and rediscover your GitHub stars. Runs on your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.seed:local: node scripts/seed-local.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of a GitHub OAuth app (github.com/settings/developers). Callback URL: `https://<worker>.<subdomain>.workers.dev/auth/callback`. Enter `none` to sign in with a personal access token instead.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the same OAuth app, or `none`.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Long random string used to encrypt GitHub tokens at rest. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins allowed to sign in. Leave empty and the first person to sign in owns this install.

CLEF_MODEL.description: Workers AI decision model: `clef-flash` (fast, cheap) or `clef` (larger).
